**Discpress 1.1 is faster.** Creating CHDs now makes full use of every CPU core you give it, so conversions finish much sooner on computers and recent phones. It also names more games correctly and is easier to read in the light theme.

## Download

**[⬇ discpress.html](https://github.com/PowerBeef/discpress/releases/download/v1.1.0/discpress.html)** (about 2.5 MB). As before, that one file is the whole app and works offline. To update, download it and use it instead of your old copy.

## What's new

### Much faster conversions

Discpress splits the work of compressing a disc across several threads. Until now, adding threads beyond two barely helped, and with DVD images (PlayStation 2, PSP) it could even slow things down. That's fixed: every extra thread now speeds things up.

On a 4-core computer with 4 threads:

| | 1.0 | 1.1 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 200 MB DVD image (PS2) | 27 s | **16 s** |
| 300 MB CD image with music tracks | 22 s | **19 s** |

That's about as fast as the desktop version of chdman on the same computer. The speed-up is bigger still in **private or incognito windows**, where saving results used to be very slow: a 1 GB DVD image went from almost 4 minutes to under a minute and a half. The number of threads is in **Settings**.

### More accurate game names

When a disc's serial number matches one release exactly, Discpress now picks that release instead of a regional variant with a similar serial. For example, a US Sega Saturn disc is no longer named after its European version. This makes identification more precise for about 150 serial numbers.

### Easier to read

In the light theme, the green "Matched by…" and "Done." text and the links in Help now have stronger contrast, so they're easier to read in bright light and for people with low vision. The dark theme is unchanged.

### Fixes

- A CHD that depends on a parent CHD with exactly the same contents could be treated as its own parent. It now waits for the real parent file.

## Same files as desktop chdman

Your CHDs are still exactly the same, byte for byte, as the ones desktop chdman 0.289 makes. Every change in this release was checked against it with a new automated test suite that converts, extracts and verifies every supported kind of disc on computer and phone screens.
